lines.en: I tap on Sara’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
It’s relatively windy out today, but that doesn’t stop me from wanting to wander around outside for a bit.
And if there is anyone I know who likes wandering around the city with me (And routinely stopping to buy candy because she is a child trapped in a woman’s body), it’s Sara.
But hey, if a few stops at convenience stores are all it takes to be seen in public with an attractive woman that’s actually close to my age...
I guess that’s a price I’m willing to pay.
: Mmn...hello?...
: Hey. You’re not just waking up now, are you?
: What time is it?...
: It’s a little past noon.
: Ngh...
: I drank too much last night...
: Yeah, that sounds on-brand.
: Want to subject yourself to sensory overload and go walk around the urban district for a little while?
: Mnh...when?
: Like, now.
: Guh...okaaaaay.
: I’ll start getting ready...
Sara hangs up and I begin to make my way to the same huge office building we normally meet at when we decide to visit that part of town.
Knowing that it will likely be a while until she gets there, I stop for coffee at a nearby cafe (One without any [[confirmed] manga club members working) and pick something up for Sara as well.
Unfortunately, she is one of those cowards who is incapable of drinking black coffee, so I wind up consuming two drinks instead of one.
That’s fine, though.
Caffeine is one of those drugs that you can’t overdose on.
Probably.
And, even in the event that I somehow did, she’ll be here to call an ambulance.
I’m sure today will proceed just fine with all of that in mind.
: You look really good for someone battling a hangover right now.
: Thanks~
: The trick is to just drink more as soon as you wake up so your brain can go back to feeling good.
: That’s not a trick, that’s alcoholism.
: I just call it having a good time.
: That is also alcoholism.
: You have a problem.
: I do not! It’s not like I do this every morning, Sensei.
: I just got a call from Haru-chan really late last night because she was feeling all lonely again.
: So the two of us did what any good friends would do and got drunk on the phone and cried to each other about all kinds of stuff.
: I’m kind of glad I don’t have any friends as close as that. That sounds horrible.
: That’s not true. I’m your friend, Sensei~
: And I think we’re plenty close.
: So close that you get to stick it in me while my daughter is downstairs. Isn’t that great?
: For us? Yes. For your daughter? No.
: Well I think it’s great.
: Don't you think it’s like...about time we told her, though?
: At least that way, we probably wouldn’t have to worry about her walking in on us.
: I prefer to keep my relationships secret, if you don’t mind.
: Especially from people as pure as Sana.
: Oh, please. She’s a growing girl. I’m sure she gets up to all sorts of stuff while she’s alone.
: Take that back. I will not allow you to tarnish that girl’s image.
: I’m just saying, I know I did when I was her age.
: But I was also having sex with my teacher when I was her age, soooo...
: Maybe I just have a thing for teachers?
: That’s not true, Sensei. I think we’re plenty close.
: Even if you won’t accept my love.
: I’ve accepted it. I just can’t return it.
: Yeah, that.
: But if you ever feel like calling me in the middle of the night to get drunk and cry, I’ll always be there. Kay?
: This is not a thing I will ever want. But thanks, Sara.
: Of course~
: Though, I suppose at this point you’d rather just call my daughter and talk to her instead, wouldn’t you?
: I’m not quite sure what you’re insinuating with that.
: Just that she’s getting awfully warmed up to you out of nowhere.
: Maybe on account of you visiting her dorm room at night?
: Maybe if I was still her size...
: Okay, anyway, why don’t we talk about something else?
: Embrace my youthful jealousy, Sensei...Embrace it~
: It’s less of a youth thing and more of an...innocence thing.
: And even then, nothing like that is even close to happening between Sana and me.
: But...if the opportunity arose...
: Come on. If there’s anyone who knows what teachers like you think about in their spare time, it’s me.
: I was barely a freshman when I started sleeping with mine.
It’s crazy right now to think of Sana doing anything remotely close to what Sara was doing back then.
Will that stop me from thinking about it? Of course not.
My mind lands on that almost every time I walk into her room.
But it’s just so far out of reach at this point that I don’t even bother addressing it.
Sara, though-
Those experiences went on to shape the rest of her life.
A lot of people say that the first few years of a child’s life are what go on to sculpt them as a person.
I don’t think I agree with that.
I think that people tend to find themselves in their[teen]years- particularly their years in [high_school].
Which is why I’m so worried about how everyone I know will eventually break down and die.
And how I, too, will become the man who abandoned Sara and her family.
: Do you regret it at all?
: What? Sleeping with my teacher?
: Yeah.
: Hmm...I guess I do sometimes.
: I definitely loved him.
: But now I have an adorable little girl who’s going to wind up becoming a better version of me when she's older. And that’s fine.
: Besides, even if he wound up being unfaithful, I needed someone like that back then.
: Have you always been this-
: Needy?
: Probably.
: Yeah, I’d say so.
: I was kind of like an...anti-Sana when I was in [high_school].
: Instead of closing myself off from everyone, I chose to stay wide open instead.
: I would have let anyone in regardless of who they were or what they wanted from me.
: And I wound up falling for the first person to ever look at me as a girl.
: Well, the first older person at least.
: There were plenty of boys who liked me back then, but I never really had any interest in them since they were all just kids.
: Like, what could they do for me that I couldn’t do for myself?
: Well, you just wanted to feel loved, right? That’s what you’re making it sound like.
: I think “protected” is a little closer to what I was looking for.
: It would make me happy when I’d get a confession from a boy, but none of them would ever make me feel as safe as someone older with more...power and stuff.
: Which is probably one more reason I like you so much.
: The only power I have is determining whether a handful of [teenage]girls will make it through their first year of [high_school] or not.
: You’ve got a lot more power than that, Sensei.
: You have an entire class of girls who look up to you and learn from you.
: And with barely any men around, you’re pretty much the only male figure they have in their lives.
: Given those kinds of circumstances, I think it’s pretty miraculous you’re as decent as you are.
: If only the same could have been said about Sana’s dad...
: I take it he was one of those people who abused his position?
: Will you think I’m dumb or gullible if I say he was?
: I think you’re dumb and gullible now.
: Hey!
: I’m kidding...
Kind of.
: Of course I won’t think that.
: I don’t know what things were like for you when you were that age, and I don’t know what must have been going through your mind in order to deal with that.
: But it’s not crazy to believe someone would have taken advantage of you in the position.
: Good recovery. I like you again.
: Good. Those ten seconds you didn’t were really suspenseful.
: Heheh~
: Either way, what’s done is done.
: All things considered, I think I’m in a pretty good place now.
: I own a business.
: That’s failing.
: I have a nice apartment.
: That you live by yourself in and are likely overpaying for.
: And I have the cutest daughter in the world.
: Who can’t hold a conversation to save her life.
: You’re mean today! Let me have something!
: You have my arm. Any more and you’ll start getting ahead of yourself.
: Oh ho ho~ Are you saying I get to keep this arm all to myself?
: Sure. For now.
: I do want something in return, though.
: Ooooh? Do we need to go somewhere a little more private, [saramaster]?
: It’s nothing like that.
: I just want you to tell me more of your story sometime.
: I’m obviously not going to call you at 2:00AM to get drunk and cry, but I’d like to hear more about how you wound up where you are now.
: I know surprisingly little about you for a girl who is allegedly “wide open.”
I’m also sure that figuring out what makes Sara tick is sure to help me grow a little closer to Sana as well.
And, even if it doesn’t, I’m interested in seeing how things got to this point.
And how I might possibly be able to avoid forcing that onto anyone else in the future.
: Do you want to get married?
: What?
: No?
: Heheh~ Just checking...
: I’d love to tell you more of my story sometime.
: And I’d love to hear yours as well.
: Yeah, I don’t know if-
: Oh! Here’s a good place to start now!
Sara lets go of my arm and skips over to a local concert hall, displaying a gigantic billboard of-
: Uh-oh.
: When I was a little girl, I wanted to be just like that one day.
: Someone the entire world would gaze at with envy.
: A person that boys would adore and that girls would look up to.
: But now I’m washed up and emotionally spent before even hitting the middle of my thirties.
: Do you like girls like that, Sensei?
: They make your heart race, don’t they?
: Or maybe they make you feel a little something else?
: Doesn’t seeing that cute girl up there make you want to just grab her and corrupt-
: Why aren’t you saying anything?
: Don’t tell me that...you wanted to look like that one day, too?...
: That...
: Is my ex-girlfriend.
: Oh, come on! Like I’d ever believe that you dated Niki.
: She’s like...an icon in Kumon-mi.
: I don’t really follow idols the way I used to, but she’s on TV all the time and...
: And you still haven’t told me you’re kidding yet...
: What are you-
: What are you doing? I have no idea who-
: Haven’t I told you not to call me in the middle of the day before?! I’m fucking busy!
: Um...is this...
: Who the fuck are you?
: A friend of...your ex-boyfriend’s...
: Is this really Niki Nakayama?
: Teehee~ Apologies, miss! That was my manager on the phone just now.
: Would you mind putting your friend on the line for sec? There's something I need to talk to him about~
: She, uhh...wants to talk to you...
: Hello?
: Are you still-
: Ah!
: You just...hung up on Niki...
: This is what’s best for everyone.
: Do you believe me now?
: You should have been able to recognize her voice if you know her, right?
: I’m...having sex with Niki Nakayama’s ex-boyfriend?...
: Did I...Did I finally make it after all?
: It’s suddenly starting to make a lot more sense why you don’t like me the same way I like you.
Sara is a little too shocked to carry on hanging out after that.
There’s also the fact that she needs to start getting ready for work, but it’s not like that’s ever stopped her before.
All things considered, I think this was a pretty good afternoon.
I got to learn a little more about Sara...and also got to make myself look a lot cooler than I actually am in the process.
Now, as long as Niki doesn’t-
: I’ll just...
: Read those later...
Sara’s affection has increased to [sara_love]!
